新功能：今日點燈、雙人配對卡: New: Daily Glow and Pair Card
做完語根測驗之後，可以每天回來點一下今天的狀態，想起自己回到穩定的方法；也可以把: After the Root Code Test, you can come back each day to tap how you are and remember how you get back to steady. You can also send a link to a friend and see how you work together. Both are under Tests in the main menu.
語根名稱可以直接點進介紹頁: Root names now link to their pages
在個人報告書和測驗結果裡看到的語根名稱，點下去就能讀到那個語根的完整介紹。首頁的: Root names in your personal report and test results now link to each root's full page. The counter on the home page also started including the new test.
頻率筆記改放創辦人在 Threads 上的原文，一共 19 篇，每篇都附原文連結: Frequency Notes now carry the founder's original Threads posts, 19 in all, each with a link to the original and a new cover. Frequency Notes and the message wall are also available in English.
右上角可以切換繁中、简中、EN。英文版包含首頁、關於我們、12 語根、三關測驗、: Switch languages at the top right: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese or English. The English version covers the home page, About, the 12 Root Codes, the three-stage test, the report, the Frequency Grid and the privacy policy.
新增留言牆，收錄大家在報名表和測驗回饋裡寫給我們的話，包括 2025 年 12: A new message wall gathers what people wrote to us in sign-up forms and test feedback, including notes from the December 2025 concert. We also started the Frequency Notes column.
完整測驗：三關一次做完: The full test: three stages in one go
語根、內在原型、內在動力三個測驗串成三關。每做完一關就先看到那一關的結果，中途離: The Root Code, Inner Archetype and Inner Drive tests now run as three stages. You see each result as you go, can leave and pick up again on the same device, and get your full report when all three are done.
每一個做完測驗的人，都會在網格裡點亮一格。我們也放進了舊測驗平台從 2025 年: Everyone who finishes the test lights up a cell in the grid. We also added results from the old test platform since August 2025, so we can all see how far we've come.
語根測驗改成 24 題的平衡版，加入同分時的決勝題，以及 144 句頻率任務語。: The Root Code Test is now a balanced 24-question version, with tie-break questions and 144 Mission Lines.
12 語根介紹頁: A page for each of the 12 Root Codes
每個語根都有自己的頁面：特質、穩定與失衡時的樣子、主題曲與小故事、代表顏色。: Each root now has its own page: traits, how it looks when steady and off balance, a theme song and story, and its colors.
全新的首頁、關於我們與三大測驗頁上線，金色光塔成為我們的新圖示。: A brand-new home page, About page and Tests page went live, and the golden light tower became our new icon.
首頁和 12 語根總覽裡「已累積多少筆測驗數據」的那兩句，現在會加上新版測驗的即: The two lines on the home page and the 12 Root Codes overview that say how many test results we have now include live results from the new test. Each time someone finishes, the number goes up by one.
